name: Single-Arm Overhead Rope Extension
description: A unilateral overhead cable extension using a single rope attachment that allows one arm to train in isolation. This targets the long head of the triceps with cable tension from below. The single-arm approach helps identify and correct strength imbalances.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Single-Arm Overhead Rope Extension in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Single-Arm Overhead Rope Extension.
steps: Step 1: Attach rope to low pulley. Stand facing away and hold rope overhead with one hand.
Step 2: Keep upper arm vertical and elbow pointing toward ceiling.
Step 3: Extend elbow to press hand up and slightly forward.
Step 4: Lower slowly behind head feeling the long head stretch.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Keep upper arm pressed against head
